strongs_1890.strongs_def: properly, a repetition, i.e. a duplicate (copy of a document), or a double (in amount); by implication, a second (in order, rank, age, quality or location)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: college, copy, double, fatlings, next, second (order), twice as much.
